directory_field_synced: This field comes from the org directory (AD/LDAP or Google Workspace); change it there.
directory_manager_cycle: This manager would create a loop in the org chart.
contacts_vcard_invalid: The file is not vCard (.vcf) or holds no contacts.
directory_csv_invalid: The CSV file has no e-mail column or no rows.
directory_person_unknown: No active member of the organization has this e-mail.
contacts_account_unavailable: This account's address book does not sync. Check the account in the calendar settings.
